items.reply: I retain TP: src/sentry/consumers/__init__.py:586–589 wraps the strategy in DlqStaleMessagesStrategyFactoryWrapper when stale_threshold_sec is set. That wrapper forwards Message(Value(FILTERED_PAYLOAD, ...)) downstream from src/sentry/consumers/dlq.py:136–138, making the decoder assertion reachable. The new queue strategy consequently logs an exception; its fallback only completes BrokerValue offsets, so it does not complete this wrapper-generated message. The claim that no upstream filter can exist overlooks this consumer-level wrapper.
